attempts.summary: Created an LVM logical volume (vgdata/lvdata) on node1 backed by two loopback files (since the node has no spare block device), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, wrote test data, then grew it online from ~1GB to 2.15GB via a second PV/vgextend/lvextend -r while remaining mounted with data intact. Set up a systemd oneshot unit (lvm-loop-setup.service) to reattach the loop devices at boot and an /etc/fstab entry for /srv/data, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy state, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until it came back, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the LV, mount, and data (via sha256sum) all recovered correctly post-restart.
